conviction_note: Nothing new was filed today and no news came out. The fall is the third straight day of decay, on 0.33x volume, in a $2.3m-cap name whose capital structure has an unfinished, price-sensitive seller (variable-price convertible notes that convert at 90% of the lowest 20-day VWAP, with resales registered under an effective shelf), so I lean slightly down (p_up 45) on a wide abs_move of 8%. That lean is pulled toward 50 by the low-volume base rate (+1.46%) and the cross-section prior (+0.5%). The one big dated supply event, a 2.8M-share resale F-3 equal to 170% of the shares outstanding, is not yet effective and most likely lands after the window.

findings.finding: The seller is structurally unfinished. L.I.A. Pure Capital holds variable-price convertible notes that settle only in shares, at the lower of a fixed price or 90% of the lowest daily VWAP over the prior 20 trading days, above a floor. Resales of the April-June 2026 notes are registered under an F-3 that went effective on 2026-06-16, so conversion shares can be sold any session, including 2026-10-13, and each lower print lowers the next conversion price.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Conversions and resales under an already-effective resale registration need no new filing or approval, so the supply can arrive inside the next session. The company has run a monthly cadence of new note financings (07-01, 08-06, 09-02, then the 10-07 settlement notes), which means the convertible supply is replenished and not running out.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The name's last 12 comparable falls in the baseline (2026-08-28 to 10-09) were followed by a lower next close 8 times, 0.0 once and a higher close 3 times (+34.2% on 09-22 after the SDI LOI, +9.28%). That pattern fits steady convertible-holder selling punctuated by news-driven spikes.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken today's fall but not the mechanics: the conversion reference price is the lowest VWAP of the trailing 20 days, so today's low resets the conversion price downward and gives the converter a fresh discount to sell into on 10-13. A price that held this would show buyers at the low on volume, and today's turnover was $123k against a 20-day median of $604k, a third of normal, so no buyer stepped in.
findings.independence: The Oct 2026 resale F-3 documents the July-September PIPE notes on the same 90%-of-lowest-VWAP terms with Pure Capital as selling holder, and new October settlement notes with a US$0.40 floor (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1792030/000117891326004744/zk2636210.htm). The Sept 29 sale-closing release itself flags liquidity and going-concern risk (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1792030/000117891326004699/exhibit_99-1.htm). Whether any April-June note principal is still unconverted is NOT established, which is why this finding is sized small.
